description: Upcoming events in one town of Île-de-France (e.g. Paris, Versailles, Saint-Germain-en-Laye), soonest first. Optional filter: this weekend, free, or for children. Returns up to 10 events and the total count; `more_url` is the full list.

filter.description: weekend = this weekend, free = free admission, kids = for children. Optional.

lang.description: Language of titles and summaries. Default: en.

name: list_city_events
title: List events in one town
